subject.title: fix(memory): search by filenames and paths

question: Should `dropMemoryPathFtsTriggers` and `ensureMemoryPathFtsTriggers` become permanent public plugin SDK APIs?
rationale: Only the bundled memory publisher currently uses these low-level lifecycle functions, and scoped SDK policy discourages exposing implementation convenience without an intentional supported contract.

options.title: Internalize lifecycle helpers
options.body: Keep trigger suspension and restoration behind an internal or higher-level bundled publication seam.

options.title: Sponsor public lifecycle API
options.body: Retain the functions with documentation and focused compatibility tests for third-party plugin consumers.

recommendation.title: Internalize lifecycle helpers
recommendation.body: Keep trigger suspension and restoration behind an internal or higher-level bundled publication seam.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the memory-host-to-SDK package boundary refactor and has the strongest history-backed ownership for this API decision.
